segments.comment: Variation of message-menu-escape-never-mind-independent: the Valkyrie's one throwable dagger is listed by wintty.c tty_message_menu(); typing its letter at the --More-- selects it (dismiss_more) and getobj() asks for a direction, which Escape cancels. A second listing cancelled by Escape prints "Never mind.", and the search afterwards shows later output is not suppressed.
